areas_token_length.name: areas_token_length
areas_token_length.value: ("areas"."color" IS NULL OR length("areas"."color") <= 32) AND ("areas"."icon" IS NULL OR length("areas"."icon") <= 32)

courses_date_order.name: courses_date_order
courses_date_order.value: "courses"."target_end_date" IS NULL OR "courses"."start_date" IS NULL OR "courses"."target_end_date" >= "courses"."start_date"

goals_date_order.name: goals_date_order
goals_date_order.value: "goals"."target_date" IS NULL OR "goals"."start_date" IS NULL OR "goals"."target_date" >= "goals"."start_date"

metric_observations_source_requirements.name: metric_observations_source_requirements
metric_observations_source_requirements.value: ("metric_observations"."source_id" <> 'src_inference' OR "metric_observations"."confidence" IS NOT NULL) AND ("metric_observations"."source_id" <> 'src_calculation' OR "metric_observations"."algorithm_version" IS NOT NULL)

goal_milestones_completed_consistency.name: goal_milestones_completed_consistency
goal_milestones_completed_consistency.value: ("goal_milestones"."status" = 'completed' AND "goal_milestones"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("goal_milestones"."status" <> 'completed' AND "goal_milestones"."completed_at" IS NULL)

projects_date_order.name: projects_date_order
projects_date_order.value: "projects"."target_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."target_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

project_milestones_completed_consistency.name: project_milestones_completed_consistency
project_milestones_completed_consistency.value: ("project_milestones"."status" = 'completed' AND "project_milestones"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_milestones"."status" <> 'completed' AND "project_milestones"."completed_at" IS NULL)

tasks_completed_consistency.name: tasks_completed_consistency
tasks_completed_consistency.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" <> 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

weekly_reviews_reflection_size.name: weekly_reviews_reflection_size
weekly_reviews_reflection_size.value:
(
      ("weekly_reviews"."worked" IS NULL OR length("weekly_reviews"."worked") <= 2000) AND
      ("weekly_reviews"."didnt_work" IS NULL OR length("weekly_reviews"."didnt_work") <= 2000) AND
      ("weekly_reviews"."learned" IS NULL OR length("weekly_reviews"."learned") <= 2000) AND
      ("weekly_reviews"."change" IS NULL OR length("weekly_reviews"."change") <= 2000) AND
      ("weekly_reviews"."focus" IS NULL OR length("weekly_reviews"."focus") <= 2000)
    )
